_comment: Rolled on top of recompile:chests/sump by loot_modifiers/sump_inscriber_presses.json (#46).
The pool is Recompile 0.20.0's pool 2 of that table, moved here unchanged.
A TAG ENTRY, NOT FOUR ITEM ENTRIES. An item id resolves when the file is parsed, so naming
ae2:silicon_press without AE2 fails the table. A tag does not, and an absent tag rolls nothing.
expand:false yields EVERY press in the tag per roll, which is AE2's own mysterious_cube mechanism
and what its guide describes: all four from one find. A fifth processor press is carried the day
AE2 adds one, and name_press stays out because AE2's tag leaves it out.
GUARANTEED, once per sump crate, like the echo shard beside it. A sewer is behind a Prybar under
the demolition yard, which is already stricter than AE2's 'fairly common' meteorites.
